sources.title: Piracy monthly report September 2024
sources.text: Four persons armed with guns and knives boarded a tug and barge underway. They took the crew hostage tied their hands and legs and secured them in the toilets and messroom. The perpetrators transferred the barge cargo into a tanker. Before escaping the persons stole cash, damaged communication and navigation equipment and stole crew and tug properties. The incident lasted approximately 8-10 hours. The Indonesian authorities are investigating the incident.
